construct: RULED, THE K2 CELL (refreshed 2026-09-21): k2_overview 40–70w (the persona's current in the element's arena) + k2_functional ≤22w (the god's own family function, re-ruled 2026-09-01) + k2_domain_readings 18–55w per ruled domain (owner construct 2026-08-19, corpus ×50 LOCKED) · adj_chips {catalyst ×3, friction ×3} 1–3w under THE KEYWORD DERIVATION CHAIN (2026-09-03) and THE VOCABULARY ZONE B1–B2 (2026-09-04) · fn_reading = the weighted three-door ledger {word, doors:{trait, scene, outside}} ×3 per pole, 35–55w per door (THE THREE DOORS 2026-09-03; corpus ×50 complete 2026-09-04) · structural_interaction = the REA_03 §4b authoring seed · k2_card = the unauthored register stub (REA_03 §4, superseded by the cell above). Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)

candidates.structural_interaction: Earth setting standard for Water cross-polarity — containment asking whether depth has form
candidates.k2_overview: Your Earth moves as the Magistrate: bedrock law, order with geological patience. You hold standards the way mountains hold borders, unmoved, unhurried, outlasting every argument. Institutions rest on people like you. The honor is real and so is the load. Survey what you carry, and set down the duties that were never yours.
candidates.k2_functional: You are the standing wall others build against: order is less your duty than your substance.

k2_domain_readings.Career: Your career is foundation work: operations, governance, the roles that hold everything up. Advancement comes as accumulated trust. Claim the title when it is due. Bedrock underasks.
k2_domain_readings.Status: Your standing is landmark-grade: slow to build, nearly impossible to erode. People locate themselves by you. Accept the monument quietly and stay reachable at ground level.
k2_domain_readings.Order: Your order is settled ground: rules that feel less like commands than terrain. Things stay where you put them. Walk the fences yearly. Even terrain shifts, and you shift last.

catalyst.define: As a catalyst, the frame runs thin. The few lines you live by are ones you drew yourself.

angles.drive: You keep every promise, including the ones that stopped making sense. Your word is what you stand on, and keeping it matters more to you than whether the promise fits your life now. People build their plans on what you say.
angles.cost_self: Whenever you give your word, you keep the promise in full. You wear reliable better than happy, and the agreements that cost more each year stay put. Your life slowly fills with old yeses made by a younger you.
angles.cost_others: Long after you stopped wanting to, you keep promises to people. Your word counts for more with you than your mood, and a promise outlives the wish behind it. Whatever you promised them still arrives, on time and in full.

angles.drive: You play fair even when it costs you the win. You only trust a rule that applies to everyone, and you keep yourself to it rather than make yourself the exception. People who lose to you still shake your hand.
angles.cost_self: Where a shortcut gets you ahead, you play fair and arrive late. Being right with yourself comes above arriving first, and the quick wins go to people who care less. A clean conscience is worth more to you than any title.
angles.cost_others: With the people closest to you, you play fair exactly as with strangers. Being fair to everyone comes before being on anyone's side, and you never pick theirs either. Your own people sometimes wanted a champion and got a referee.

angles.drive: You set the standard before anyone asks for one. You would rather set a clear standard than argue over one, and the one you set binds you first. Around you, everyone knows what good looks like.
angles.cost_self: Wherever a standard is missing, you set one and live under it. You take your own bar as the measure over anyone else's, and yours sits a step above you. Your best days still feel like falling short.
angles.cost_others: You set a standard for the whole group. You would rather people see the bar than guess at it, and you meet it yourself before you ask it of them. Your group works to a mark it had no say in choosing.

friction.define: As a friction, the frame decides for you. You need to feel on solid ground, and your own judgement goes unused.

angles.drive: You follow every rule, including the ones nobody checks. You like knowing where you stand more than deciding for yourself, and you follow rules written for someone else too. Your own good sense is permission enough.
angles.cost_self: Whenever a rule and a chance pull apart, you follow the rule. Order weighs more than luck with you, and the chances that need a rule stretched pass you by. You hand those openings to rules nobody checks.
angles.cost_others: You follow rules even with the people who need an exception. You find fair by the book easier than kind off it, and you hand them policy instead of a decision. You keep from them the exception that was yours to give.

angles.drive: You wait for permission to take what you have earned. An approval from above counts for more with you than your own certainty, and you sit on a plan until someone signs it. You need nobody's signature on a plan that is already yours.
angles.cost_self: Where a step up is there for the asking, you wait for permission. You count a handed thing as more earned than a claimed one, and you hold off until someone offers it. Year after year, you miss what one question would bring.
angles.cost_others: You wait for permission for everyone waiting on you. Being cleared from above sits better with you than moving on your own say, and you keep the people behind you waiting. You hold up their work for a go-ahead you had all along.

angles.drive: You are slow to change, and slow on purpose. You trust what has held more than anything untested, and a new way earns years before it gets a week. By staying put, you miss the years a better way would have given.
angles.cost_self: Whenever something needs changing, you change it last. You would sooner keep what you know than find out what else there is, and you stay in a job you stopped liking for years. You let the deciding years pass in a place you outgrew.
angles.cost_others: Even for those who need you to, you change slowly. Changing for one person feels less fair to you than keeping things the same, and you keep that person waiting. You make them live the old way while you decide.

edge.lead: Earth runs through your family, your social life and your career. It is the promise at home kept without a reminder, the decision both sides of an argument can live with, and the work left in your hands because you never let it slip.
